trello.name: Add queue depth alerting to worker fleet
trello.desc: Kofi to add alerting on queue depth for the entire worker fleet (not just payments) in one pass, with warning at 1,000 jobs and page at 5,000 jobs thresholds.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic with dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Marta to fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py (_process_with_retry): implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the retries, and send failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back of the queue instead of re-enqueuing at the front. Add tests that simulate processor 503s.

trello.name: Bump and split DB connection pools
trello.desc: Kofi to make one config change that both bumps the DB connection pool from the default 20 to 100 and splits worker and API pools so they no longer share the same pool.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Priya to update the payment incident runbook: replace old Kibana links with current logging links, document the queue drain procedure Kofi improvised during the outage, and verify escalation phone numbers are current (one still routes to someone who left last year). Kofi to confirm the assignment with Priya after the meeting.

trello.name: Automate status page updates on checkout alert
trello.desc: Marta to automate status page updates using the status provider's API: when the checkout error rate alert fires, the status page flips to 'investigating' automatically with a template message. Wire to the checkout alert first; can extend to other alerts later.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Kofi to draft a plan for a controlled chaos test of the secondary payment processor failover: staging first, then production during a low-traffic window, with a rollback plan. The team reviews the draft in two weeks. No execution until the plan is reviewed and approved.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Kofi to upgrade Redis from EOL version 6.0 to 7.2. Requires a proper change window (not a casual Friday deploy) due to a config rename and changed persistence defaults. Schedule with the infra calendar.
